known_rules.symptom: Adding, removing or relocating a type declaration changes emitted code in an unchanged function of the same translation unit.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Declaration visibility or multiplicity changes GCC 4.4.1 compilation state. The precise internal UID or pass cause must be established per case.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Compare full-TU overlays with the locked compiler, preserve the exact witness body, and inspect effective code after resolving same-CU call targets. Seek historical declaration evidence before accepting a context edit.

known_rules.symptom: First differing instruction is a constant SUB ESP prologue allocation.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Not established by the allocation alone. Different local widths, spills, outgoing arguments, lifetimes or source expansion can change the frame.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Check the attached DWARF local-width evidence and calls before experimenting with register temporaries. Preserve x87 and historical flags; never change a frame size or padding to mask a source mismatch.
